decisions.normalizedClaim: Anquam Mahamoud supports funding Minneapolis water-distribution infrastructure and deeply affordable public housing.
decisions.supportingExcerpt: I introduced legislation funding water distribution infrastructure improvements for the City of Minneapolis and a bill to support the Minneapolis Public Housing Authority’s efforts to provide deeply affordable housing units, which I learned about during our visit to Spring Manor earlier this year.

decisions.normalizedClaim: Paul Novotny supports authorizing Safe Haven Baby Boxes so parents in crisis can anonymously and safely surrender newborns.
decisions.supportingExcerpt: I am committed to fighting for this legislation, and I hope to see it move forward with strong support.

decisions.normalizedClaim: Kristin Bahner supports HOA and common-interest-community reforms that strengthen consumer protections and oversight.
decisions.supportingExcerpt: Working with a bipartisan group of legislators, I plan to introduce a reform package that will strengthen consumer protection laws and ensure Minnesotans are not taken advantage of by these quasi-government organizations with little oversight.

decisions.normalizedClaim: Leigh Dawn Finke supports passage of an inclusive Minnesota Equal Rights Amendment.
decisions.supportingExcerpt: I am honored to be the lead House author for the ERA this session and was excited to meet with a broad collection of leaders working to ensure the passage of an inclusive ERA in Minnesota. This has been a hard-fought effort, but I am committed to ensuring this important constitutional amendment is victorious.

decisions.normalizedClaim: Marion Rarick supports stricter fraud reporting requirements and additional fraud-prevention tools for state agencies.
decisions.supportingExcerpt: House File 2 (I’m a co-author): Strengthens fraud prevention by mandating stricter reporting requirements for state agencies and equipping them with additional tools to identify and prevent fraudulent activities.

decisions.normalizedClaim: Robert Bierman supports safe patient-to-staff ratios and legislative solutions that uphold patient-care standards.
decisions.supportingExcerpt: Safe patient-to-staff ratios are critical in this work, and as the co-chair of the Health Finance Committee, it's an honor to partner with them on legislative solutions that uphold the standard of care Minnesotans expect and deserve.

decisions.normalizedClaim: Josiah Hill supports protecting the rights of LGBTQ, Black and Brown, and immigrant communities from discriminatory government action.
decisions.supportingExcerpt: I will fight to protect the rights of our LGBTQ, Black and Brown, and immigrant communities.
